items.definitionEn: A need or expectation expressed by a stakeholder.
items.explanationVi: Nhu cầu hoặc kỳ vọng của stakeholder; là đầu vào để hình thành system requirements.
items.questionEn: What is a stakeholder need?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: A need states what stakeholders want; a system requirement defines what the system shall do.
items.explanationVi: Stakeholder need nói stakeholder muốn gì; system requirement chuyển thành yêu cầu kỹ thuật mà system phải thực hiện.
items.questionEn: How do stakeholder needs differ from system requirements?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Requirements Elicitation.
items.explanationVi: Thu thập và xác định nhu cầu/yêu cầu từ các stakeholder, bao gồm source và agreement.
items.questionEn: What is the purpose of SYS.1?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: System Requirements Analysis.
items.explanationVi: Phân tích và chuyển stakeholder needs thành system requirements rõ ràng, khả thi, nhất quán và có thể verify.
items.questionEn: What is the purpose of SYS.2?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: System Architectural Design.
items.explanationVi: Thiết kế system architecture, allocation, interfaces, dynamic behavior và rationale.
items.questionEn: What is the purpose of SYS.3?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Criteria such as correctness, completeness, consistency, feasibility, verifiability and traceability.
items.explanationVi: Requirement cần đúng, đủ, nhất quán, khả thi, test/verify được và trace được.
items.questionEn: What makes a system requirement high quality?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Criteria that must be satisfied before an artifact proceeds to the next stage.
items.explanationVi: Bộ điều kiện xác định requirement/design đã đủ rõ, đủ chất lượng và sẵn sàng chuyển sang bước tiếp theo.
items.questionEn: What is a Definition of Ready?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Assignment of system functions or requirements to system elements.
items.explanationVi: Phân bổ function hoặc requirement cho component/system element phù hợp.
items.questionEn: What does allocation mean in system architecture?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: A defined interaction boundary between system elements.
items.explanationVi: Điểm và quy tắc giao tiếp giữa các component, mô tả dữ liệu hoặc tương tác trao đổi.
items.questionEn: What does an architecture interface describe?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: The reasoning that explains why an architectural decision was made.
items.explanationVi: Lý do giải thích tại sao architecture hoặc design được chọn theo cách đó.
items.questionEn: What is architectural rationale?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: The ability to trace artifacts forward and backward across development levels.
items.explanationVi: Có thể trace cả xuôi và ngược giữa stakeholder, requirements, architecture, design và test.
items.questionEn: What does bidirectional traceability mean?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: A requirement that has no corresponding downstream design or implementation link.
items.explanationVi: Requirement không có liên kết tới design/implementation phía sau, cần được phát hiện và xử lý.
items.questionEn: What is an orphan requirement?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: A controlled version of an artifact used as an approved reference.
items.explanationVi: Phiên bản artifact đã được review/kiểm soát và dùng làm reference chính thức cho downstream.
items.questionEn: What is a baseline in ASPICE work?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Software Requirements Analysis.
items.explanationVi: Phân tích system requirements để xác định software requirements rõ ràng, khả thi, testable và traceable.
items.questionEn: What is the purpose of SWE.1?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Software Architectural Design.
items.explanationVi: Thiết kế software architecture, component, interface, dependency, data/control flow và behavior.
items.questionEn: What is the purpose of SWE.2?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Software Detailed Design and Unit Construction.
items.explanationVi: Đi từ software architecture xuống detailed design, unit và code, giữ consistency và traceability.
items.questionEn: What is the purpose of SWE.3?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: A linkage from system requirements through software requirements, architecture, design and code.
items.explanationVi: Chuỗi trace: SYS requirement → SWE.1 → SWE.2 → SWE.3 → code.
items.questionEn: What is the typical SYS-to-SWE trace chain?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Analysis of artifacts and tests affected by a change.
items.explanationVi: Phân tích requirement/design/code/test nào bị ảnh hưởng khi một artifact thay đổi.
items.questionEn: What is change impact analysis used for?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Verification checks conformity to specification; validation checks suitability for intended use.
items.explanationVi: Verification: làm đúng specification chưa? Validation: sản phẩm có phù hợp intended use không?
items.questionEn: What is the difference between verification and validation?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Software Unit Verification.
items.explanationVi: Verification ở mức unit, kiểm tra unit có phù hợp với detailed design hay không.
items.questionEn: What does SWE.4 verify?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Software Integration and Integration Test.
items.explanationVi: Kiểm tra các software components sau khi integration, tập trung vào interface và interaction.
items.questionEn: What does SWE.5 verify?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Software Qualification Test.
items.explanationVi: Qualification test ở mức software, dùng software requirements làm test basis.
items.questionEn: What does SWE.6 qualify?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: System Integration and Integration Test.
items.explanationVi: Tích hợp các system elements và kiểm tra interface, interaction giữa chúng.
items.questionEn: What does SYS.4 verify?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: System Qualification Test.
items.explanationVi: Qualification test ở mức system, dùng system requirements làm test basis.
items.questionEn: What does SYS.5 qualify?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Validation.
items.explanationVi: Chứng minh sản phẩm phù hợp với intended use và operational context.
items.questionEn: What is the purpose of VAL.1?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: A strategy defining objectives, criteria, test selection, coverage, environment and execution approach.
items.explanationVi: Chiến lược V&V xác định mục tiêu, criteria, lựa chọn test, coverage, environment và cách thực thi.
items.questionEn: What should a V&V strategy define?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: A trace chain connecting a requirement to its test, result and test configuration.
items.explanationVi: Chuỗi evidence: requirement → test case/execution → result → configuration đã được test.
items.questionEn: What is the key test evidence chain?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: The controlled software, hardware, environment and configuration used for test execution.
items.explanationVi: Thông tin xác định chính xác version software, hardware, environment và configuration khi test.
items.questionEn: Why must test configuration be recorded?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: A detected discrepancy or unexpected result requiring analysis and controlled resolution.
items.explanationVi: Sai khác hoặc kết quả bất thường được phát hiện trong test và cần được phân tích, xử lý có kiểm soát.
items.questionEn: What is an anomaly in verification?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Testing performed after a change to check that existing functionality still works.
items.explanationVi: Sau khi sửa lỗi/thay đổi, chạy lại các test liên quan để kiểm tra chức năng cũ không bị hỏng.
items.questionEn: Why is regression testing performed?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Defined conditions that must be met before a test phase can be considered complete.
items.explanationVi: Điều kiện phải đạt trước khi kết thúc test, thay vì kết thúc chỉ vì hết thời gian.
items.questionEn: What are test exit criteria?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: A summary of test execution, results, coverage, anomalies and overall status.
items.explanationVi: Báo cáo tổng hợp planned, executed, passed, failed, coverage, anomalies và trạng thái test.
items.questionEn: What does a test summary report contain?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: The purpose for which the product is intended to be used.
items.explanationVi: Mục đích sử dụng mà sản phẩm được thiết kế để đáp ứng.
items.questionEn: What does intended use mean in validation?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: The real or defined operating context in which the product is intended to be used.
items.explanationVi: Bối cảnh vận hành mà sản phẩm được dự kiến sử dụng, gồm các điều kiện và scenario liên quan.
items.questionEn: Why is operational context important for validation?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Requirements define what; architecture defines how; verification proves conformity; validation checks intended use.
items.explanationVi: WHAT = requirements; HOW = architecture/design; PROVE = verification; USE = validation.
items.questionEn: What four words summarize the ASPICE flow?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.definitionEn: Four key controls for maintaining consistency and proving engineering results.
items.explanationVi: Trace mọi artifact; baseline version được kiểm soát; test theo basis; lưu evidence để chứng minh.
items.questionEn: What four keywords summarize the project control flow?

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation
